risk_paths.summary: Comma-separated path globs of the risky code the security-isolation lens reads: authorization, secrets, deletion and resources another owner holds. A glob matches a repository path as fnmatch does, so * also crosses a directory separator; a changed path that matches any glob brings the lens in.

lens_changed_lines.summary: Lines added plus lines removed in the product and test paths of the Item's frozen change against its base, as git diff --numstat counts them outside workspace/docs, above which the correctness-contract and conformance-tests lenses join; at or under it they stay out.

triggers.changed_path_matches: A changed path of the frozen change matches a glob of the parameter.
triggers.changed_lines_above: The frozen change's changed lines exceed the parameter.
